assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is PR-204.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness.
The clinical indication note raises concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The diagnosis code for transient cerebral ischemic attacks is G45.9.
The note states that prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms and dizziness.
The determination was that the service is not covered.
